Team —

Hi Marissa / team —

Thanks for the note. Zendesk can be flexible if Intercom and Gainsight are willing to confirm their commercial levers. High level:
- Zendesk can offer a 7–10% discount on Support seats if contracted for 12 months with standard terms.
- We can contribute a one-time $12k onboarding credit if Acme signs before April 15.

If Intercom can match a similar concession, we could be willing to increase to ~12% blended pricing when combined with a joint renewal timeline. Happy to set a short call to hash details — I can bring our channel renewal lead.

Best,
